solutionSql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM customers AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments AS s WHERE s.customer_id = c.id AND s.weight_kg >= 900) ORDER BY c.id;

rules.howSolved: EXISTS is a semi-join, so each customer appears at most once.
The filter is s.weight_kg >= 900, so exactly 900 qualifies.

notes: Read-only item. Ran without error on sample, nulls, ties and boundary. Solve time is an estimate.
